properties.name: zeta.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Enable periodic TopK decay, expelled-key drain, and TopK-admission promotion scheduling.

properties.name: zeta.report.enabled
properties.description: Enable app-to-Worker report aggregation and publishing via AMQP.

properties.name: zeta.local.top-k
properties.description: HeavyKeeper top-K capacity (maximum number of tracked hot keys).

properties.name: zeta.local.width
properties.description: HeavyKeeper sketch width (number of columns in the Count-Min Sketch matrix).

properties.name: zeta.local.depth
properties.description: HeavyKeeper sketch depth (number of hash rows).

properties.name: zeta.local.decay
properties.description: HeavyKeeper decay factor applied during periodic decay.

properties.name: zeta.local.min-count
properties.description: Minimum frequency count before a key is considered for the top-K ranking.

properties.name: zeta.local.cache.max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of L1 cache entries.

properties.name: zeta.local.cache.tombstone-maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of per-key invalidation tombstones kept for the anti-resurrection guard.

properties.name: zeta.local.cache.tombstone-ttl-seconds
properties.description: Retention in seconds for per-key invalidation tombstones; only has to outlive in-flight reads.

properties.name: zeta.local.in-flight-max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of in-flight SingleFlight deduplication entries.

properties.name: zeta.local.in-flight-ttl-seconds
properties.description: TTL in seconds for in-flight deduplication entries; must exceed the slowest remote data source response.

properties.name: zeta.local.in-flight-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Execution timeout in seconds for one in-flight cache load; queue wait is not counted.

properties.name: zeta.local.sketch-window-count
properties.description: Sliding-window depth per sketch slot (ring buffer). Range 2–10; rounded up to a power of two.

properties.name: zeta.local.executor-core-pool-size
properties.description: Core pool size for the async cache-loading executor.

properties.name: zeta.local.executor-max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum pool size for the async cache-loading executor; must be >= executor-core-pool-size.

properties.name: zeta.local.executor-queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity for the async cache-loading executor.

properties.name: zeta.local.executor-rejection
properties.description: Rejection policy when the executor queue and max pool are saturated: abort throws RejectedExecutionException, caller-runs runs the task on the submitting thread. Only the refresh fan-out pool honors caller-runs; the load and send pools always abort, and a load-pool rejection is a suppressed read, never a miss.

properties.name: zeta.local.scheduler-pool-size
properties.description: Pool size for the shared HotKey scheduler (periodic tasks).

properties.name: zeta.local.expelled-queue-capacity
properties.description: Capacity of the expelled-key queue (for keys evicted from the top-K ranking).

properties.name: zeta.local.hard-ttl-ms
properties.description: Hard TTL in milliseconds for normal keys; 0 means permanent (no hard expiry).

properties.name: zeta.local.hot-hard-ttl-ms
properties.description: Hard TTL in milliseconds for hot keys; 0 means permanent (no hard expiry).

properties.name: zeta.local.soft-ttl-ms
properties.description: Soft TTL in milliseconds for normal keys; 0 disables soft expiry.

properties.name: zeta.local.hot-soft-ttl-ms
properties.description: Soft TTL in milliseconds for hot keys; 0 disables soft expiry.

properties.name: zeta.local.ttl-jitter-ratio
properties.description: Jitter ratio (0.0-1.0) applied to TTLs e.g. 0.05 means +/- 5% random offset.

properties.name: zeta.local.refresh-max-pools
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent background refreshes for soft-expired cache entries. 0 (default) derives half of executor-max-pool-size; refreshes share that pool with read-miss loads, so a value above the pool size is clamped to executor-max-pool-size.

properties.name: zeta.app-name
properties.description: Application name used for report routing, queue naming, and the appName isolation header. One key shared by the App side and the Worker side — both ends always agree by construction.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-exchange
properties.description: Name of the DirectExchange for app-to-Worker report messages.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds between periodic report flushes.

properties.name: zeta.local.detect-interval-ms
properties.description: Maximum elapsed time in milliseconds between two sketch ingests on the shared access counter; also the access-counter tide base when no reporter is wired.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-interval-tuning
properties.description: Feed-loop tuning mode for the reporter flush cadence (design decisions: reporting): off disables the tuner; shadow computes and exposes the interval trajectory via the zeta.reporter.feedloop.* gauges without applying it; on applies each computed interval to the WaveCounter tide base.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-interval-target-batch
properties.description: Goal keys per flush for the feed-loop tuner (N); the loop settles the interval at which the smoothed arrival rate projects to this batch size. Only meaningful when report-interval-tuning != off.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-interval-min-ms
properties.description: Flush-interval floor for the feed-loop tuner (scheduler cadence bound; the WaveCounter tide floor is 50ms, so lower values are effectively 50). Only meaningful when report-interval-tuning != off.

properties.name: zeta.local.report-interval-max-ms
properties.description: Flush-interval ceiling for the feed-loop tuner — the detection-lag bound: a new hot key waits at most this long before its first report reaches the Worker. The empty-tide ladder stretches to 2x the tuned base, so the effective idle worst case is 2x this value. Should be >= report-interval-min-ms. Only meaningful when report-interval-tuning != off.

properties.name: zeta.local.queue-capacity
properties.description: Capacity of the reporter dispatch work queue, in batches. Consumers blocked on a publish cannot drain, so this bounds a stalled broker's backlog; 1024 batches covers one 5 s staleness window at up to ~200 batches/s.

properties.name: zeta.local.queue-offer-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout in milliseconds for offering a batch to the report queue.

properties.name: zeta.local.consumer-count
properties.description: Number of report queue consumer threads (0 = auto: max(4, availableProcessors/2)).

properties.name: zeta.local.consistent-hashing.enabled
properties.description: Gate for the /actuator/hotkeyring inspection endpoint. Report routing always uses the consistent-hash ring (there is no separate routing switch); set false to hide the inspection endpoint.

properties.name: zeta.local.consistent-hashing.virtual-nodes
properties.description: Number of virtual nodes per physical Worker in the consistent-hash ring.

properties.name: zeta.local.instance-id
properties.description: Per-instance identifier for queue naming. Overrides auto-detected instance-id.

properties.name: zeta.local.node-id
properties.description: Explicit 10-bit dataVersion node id (0..1023), embedded in every stamp the stamp clock mints. When unset it is derived from the instance id.

properties.name: zeta.local.clock-max-forward-drift-ms
properties.description: Largest forward distance (ms) an observed peer stamp may lead local physical time before the stamp clock refuses to raise its floor. Rejects broken clocks, not ordinary NTP skew; the message itself is still applied.

properties.name: zeta.local.heartbeat.exchange-name
properties.description: Heartbeat exchange name for worker liveliness detection.

properties.name: zeta.local.heartbeat.timeout-ms
properties.description: Heartbeat timeout in ms. With adaptive-timeout on it is the warm-up window and the ceiling of the per-Worker Jacobson/Karels estimate; with it off it is the fixed liveness threshold.

properties.name: zeta.local.heartbeat.min-alive-workers
properties.description: Minimum alive Workers for cluster health; 0 = one third of observed Workers, rounded up, minimum 1 (design decisions: heartbeat and health).

properties.name: zeta.sync.flush-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in ms before pending sync records are flushed.

properties.name: zeta.sync.max-defer-ms
properties.description: Maximum deferral in ms before a flush is forced, even under continuous writes.

properties.name: zeta.sync.put-max-bytes
properties.description: Upper bound (bytes) for a single value-carrying PUT payload; a write over the bound (or not Jackson-round-trippable) degrades to a value-less REFRESH.

properties.name: zeta.sync.put-allowed-packages
properties.description: Extra package prefixes admitted by the PUT deserialization whitelist. The built-in whitelist keeps JDK value types and io.github.hyshmily.zeta.*; a business DTO outside both fails closed and degrades to a versioned INVALIDATE.

properties.name: zeta.sync.max-pending-units
properties.description: Global cap (weighted units, ~1 KB each) on tasks pending in the per-key sync dispatcher; new tasks are dropped when exhausted.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.enabled
properties.description: Enable sliding-window circuit breaker for remote calls (disabled by default).

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.window-time-ms
properties.description: Sliding window duration in ms.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.window-buckets
properties.description: Number of buckets dividing the sliding window.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.fail-threshold
properties.description: Failure rate threshold (0.0–1.0); opens breaker when exceeded.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.request-volume-threshold
properties.description: Minimum total requests before evaluating failure rate.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.single-test-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in ms between half-open probe requests.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.half-open-max-probes
properties.description: Maximum concurrent probe requests in HALF_OPEN state.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.consecutive-success-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive probe successes in HALF_OPEN required to close (anti-flapping).

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.max-prefixes
properties.description: Maximum live per-prefix circuit-breaker shards. An annotated key shards on the cache namespace before the U+0000 namespace delimiter; a programmatic key on the segment before the first ':'; a key with neither shares one bucket. Bounds memory when the key space is unbounded (LRU eviction past the cap); one sick datasource trips only its own shard.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.log-enabled
properties.description: Whether to log state transitions (OPEN/CLOSE/HALF-OPEN).

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.exclude-exceptions
properties.description: Exception class names that should NOT trip the breaker.

properties.name: zeta.local.circuit-breaker.include-exceptions
properties.description: Exception class names that SHOULD trip the breaker (empty = all).

properties.name: zeta.sync.enabled
properties.description: Enable cross-instance cache synchronization (INVALIDATE/REFRESH/PUT) over RabbitMQ.

properties.name: zeta.sync.exchange-name
properties.description: Name of the FanoutExchange for cache sync messages.

properties.name: zeta.sync.queue-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for the per-instance sync queue name.

properties.name: zeta.sync.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether the sync listener container starts automatically.

properties.name: zeta.sync.dedup-window-seconds
properties.description: Time window in seconds for deduplicating duplicate sync messages.

properties.name: zeta.sync.dedup-max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries in the sync deduplication cache.

properties.name: zeta.sync.jitter-ms
properties.description: Maximum random jitter in ms parked before a key's first sync cache-update cycle (one draw per key-dispatch burst).

properties.name: zeta.sync.concurrent-consumers
properties.description: Number of concurrent consumers for the sync listener.

properties.name: zeta.sync.scheduler-pool-size
properties.description: Pool size for the sync scheduler (jittered cache-update tasks).

properties.name: zeta.sync.prefetch-count
properties.description: AMQP prefetch count for the sync listener.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.enabled
properties.description: Enable listening for Worker HOT/COOL decisions over RabbitMQ.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.exchange-name
properties.description: Name of the DirectExchange for Worker decision broadcasts. Must match zeta.worker.messaging.broadcast-exchange.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.queue-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for the per-instance Worker decision queue name.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.auto-startup
properties.description: Whether the Worker listener container starts automatically.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.jitter-ms
properties.description: Maximum random jitter in ms before applying Worker broadcasts. 0 = immediate.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.concurrent-consumers
properties.description: Number of concurrent consumers for the Worker decision listener.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.scheduler-pool-size
properties.description: Pool size for the Worker listener scheduler (jittered cache-update tasks).

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.prefetch-count
properties.description: AMQP prefetch count for the Worker listener.

properties.name: zeta.worker-listener.max-pending-units
properties.description: Global cap (weighted units, ~1 KB each) on tasks pending in the per-key Worker-decision dispatcher.

properties.name: zeta.local.heartbeat.adaptive-timeout
properties.description: Per-Worker adaptive liveness windows: the effective timeout is the Jacobson/Karels estimate over heartbeat inter-arrival, clamped into [adaptive-floor-ms, timeout-ms].

properties.name: zeta.local.heartbeat.adaptive-floor-ms
properties.description: Lower clamp (ms) for the adaptive liveness window; must be <= timeout-ms and stay above a few heartbeat intervals.
